searchText: The EIPs repository has a pretty severe spam problem. The most effective thing you can do is report them. GitHub does actually delete spam accounts. I believe the reason they do it is so they can have a GitHub profile that shows up as connected to Ethereum core development, and then they use that profile as part of a scam. Essentially they are trying to fake reputation farm. I deal with and report many such accounts every day.
